sadukkha.p: [ saha +dukkha ] (ti) CL=7 (1) It is afflicted with Kilesā suffering. (2) It has an afflicted body (or) It happens together with the body's suffering. (3) It has a miserable mind (or) It happens together with the miserable mind. (4) It can cause suffering. (5) One who has suffering (such as body and mind).

[dukkha + pakkhika 2 ], associated with pain or distress ; Spk III 152, 4 (vighātapakkhiyā ti ~ā); — °- (p)paṭikūla , °-paṭikkūla, mfn. , averse to pain or distress; finding pain repugnant ; D II 330, 9 (passāmi samaṇabrāhmaṇe … ~e, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-paṭikkūle); M I 315, 36 (puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo ~o, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se °-paṭikkūlo) ≠ Nidd I 8, 7 ( Se so; Be, Ce, Ee °-paṭikkūlo; Nidd-a I 37, 24 : dukkhaṃ anicchamāno); Vism 297, 11 (ahaṃ sukhakāmo ~o, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce °-paṭikkūlo); Pj II 493, 12 (~-tāya, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-paṭikkūlatāya); Paṭis-a 612, 15 (~-ttā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-paṭikkūlatta); — °- panūdaka , °-panudana, mfn. , who drives away distress ; Pv-a 114, 16 (ayaṃ ca devaputto … amhākaṃ ~o bahūpakāro, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee °-panudano); — °- vaḍḍhika , mfn. , increasing pain or distress ; Mp II 163, 13 (°’-udrayā ti ~ā); — °- vinaya , m. , the removal of dukkha; S I 22, 22* (aghavinayā ~o; Spk I 63, 1 foll. : pañcakhandhavinayena vaṭṭadukkhaṃ vinītam eva hoti); — °- vedanī̆ya , mfn. , entailing painful or unpleasant feelings or experiences ; M III 214, 9 (pāpakammaṃ ~aṃ); S II 96, 31 (~aṃ bhikkhave phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā); A II 196, 29 (~ā āsavā); IV 382, 17 (Mp IV 175, 13 : ~an ti dukkhavedanājanakakammaṃ); — °- vedi(n) , mfn. , feeling pain or discomfort ; Ja V 435, 2* (dīghaṃ ca assasati ~inī, Be, Ce so; Ee dukkha vediti; Se dukkhavedanaṃ ca vediyati); — °- vepakka , mfn. , having painful or unpleasant consequences ; Sn 537; — °- samudaya , m. , the cause, the origin, of dukkha; Vin I 10, 31 (idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave ~aṃ ariyasaccaṃ yāyaṃ taṇhā … seyyathīdaṃ kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavatanhā); III 5, 24 (ayaṃ ~o ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ); D I 192, 1 (ayaṃ ~o ti … mayā ekaṃsiko dhammo desito paññatto); M I 191, 4 (yo imesu pañcas’ upādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo … so ~o); Vibh 101, 22 (katamaṃ ~o ariyasaccaṃ); Mil 334, 27 ; Sv 916, 5 (tass’ eva dukkhassa pabhāvikā janikā taṇhā ~o ti); Nidd-a I 43, 7 (~-tāya, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~-ttā); — °- saha , mfn. [dukkha + saha 2 ], enduring pain or distress ; Cp-a 312, 18 ; — adukkha , mfn. and n. , free from pain or distress; what is not dukkha; M III 231, 2 (~o eso dhammo anupaghāto …); 231, 34 (sabbe te ~ā anupaghātā …); A II 52, 5 (~e bhikkhave dukkhan ti saññāvipallāso); Ja I 3, 23 (evambhūtena mayā ajātiṃ ajaraṃ avyādhiṃ ~aṃ asukhaṃ sītalaṃ amatamahānibbānaṃ pariyesituṃ vaṭṭati); Ps IV 101, 16 (~am eva attabhāvaṃ nibbatteti); — adukkhena, without trouble, easily ; Sv 406, 2 ; — adukkha-m-asukha, n. and mfn. , (a state of) neither pleasure nor pain; (what is) neither pleasant nor unpleasant; free from pleasure or pain ; Vin I 34, 20 (vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā ~-m-asukhaṃ vā taṃ pi ādittaṃ); III 4, 16 (~-m-asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ; Sp 155, 10 : ~-m-asukhan ti dukkhābhāvena adukkhaṃ sukhābhāvena asukhaṃ eten’ ettha dukkhasukha-paṭipakkhabhūtaṃ tatiyavedanaṃ dīpeti na dukkhasukhābhāvamattaṃ, tatiyavedanā nāma adukkhā asukhā upekkhā ti pi vuccati, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce vedanā nāma ~-m-asukhā); D II 66, 16 (tisso … vedanā sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā ~-m-asukhā vedanā); M I 293, 12 (sukhaṃ pi vedeti dukkhaṃ pi vedeti ~-m-asukhaṃ pi vedeti); A IV 442, 21 (tassa mayhaṃ … ~-m-asukhe cittaṃ na pakkhandati); Paṭis-a 140, 18 (sā hi vedanā na dukkhā na sukhā ti ~-m-asukhā ti vuccati, makāro pan’ ettha padasandhivasena vutto); — adukkha-m-asukhi(n), mfn. , experiencing neither pain nor pleasure ; D I 31, 14 (~-m-asukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā saññī ti); M II 234, 3 (~-m-asukhī attā ca loko ca); — atidukkha , n. and mfn. , 1. ( n. ) a great pain; excessive distress ; Ja V 297, 3 (~aṃ anubhoti); Vism 41, 22 ; Dhp-a I 256, 21 (~ena no sattadivasā atikkantā); — 2. ( mfn. ) very painful or unpleasant; too distressing ; Sp 1021, 14 (imesaṃ pabbajjā ~ā ti); Ps I 144, 22 (tādisena vuttaṃ nātidukkhaṃ hotī ti); — atidukkham eva in Ee at Pv-a 65, 4 is prob. wr for arati dukkham eva ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — niddukkha , mfn. , free from pain or distress; free from trouble ; Ja II 146, 24´ (sabbe averā avyāpajjā sukhī ~ā hontū ti); VI 224, 32´ (akasirā ti ~ā); 286, 24´ (~-tā); Vism 297, 24 ; Spk III 112, 17 (~-ttā anītikaṃ); — sadukkha , mfn. , causing or feeling pain or distress ; M III 230, 28 (yo … somanassānuyogo … ~o eso dhammo sa-upaghāto …; Ps V 31, 4 : vipākadukkhena pi kilesadukkhena pi ~o); 231, 30 (ye … somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā … sabbe te ~ā sa-upaghāta …); Ap 190, 15 (āturānaṃ ~ānaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se sudukkhīnaṃ); Ps IV 101, 9 (~am eva attabhāvaṃ nibbatteti); — see also taṃdukkha ( sv ta[d] ), yaṃdukkha ( sv ya[d] ).

sadutiyaka.p: [ sadutiya + ka. ] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī- sadutiyikā.] (1) It has a companion (such as a baby son). (2) It is being together with a companion. (1) (1) manussā evamāhaṃsu dethāyyāya bhikkhaṃ, sadutiyikā ayyā" ti. Vi, 2. 418.  (2) See below.

DOP: dutiyaka mf (-ikā) n. and m.f. [ cf S. dvitīyaka], 1. ( mfn. ) a second; a further ; Vin V 87, 8* (aniyatā dutiyikā, scil. āpatti? Sp 1307, 6 : dutiyaṃ aniyatasikkhāpadaṃ); Ap 45, 11 (ito ~e kappe); Spk II 34, 7 (lāmakanto ~o); Mhv 34:28 (putto ~o); — dutiyakaṃ, adv. , a second time, further ; M I 83, 5 (na ca maṃ ~aṃ uttariṃ paripuccheyyuṃ); — 2. ( i ) ( m.f. ) (being) a companion ; Vin IV 270, 24 (dutiyikaṃ pi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojeti); 297, 30 (pariyesitvā dutiyikaṃ bhikkhuniṃ na labhati); Vism 83, 2 foll. (bhikkhuniyā hi dutiyikaṃ vinā vasituṃ na vaṭṭati, evarūpe ca ṭhāne samānacchandā dutiyikā dullabhā); Sp 913, 8 (yattha ṭhitaṃ dutiyikā passati); Kkh 2 197, 26 (bhikkhusmiṃ ~e sati); Spk I 35, 4 (attano nisajjaphāsukaṃ kathāphāsukaṃ ~aṃ alabhantī); It-a II 156, 31 (taṇhaṃ pana dutiyikaṃ sahāyikaṃ labhitvā va saṃsarati); Th-a I 230, 19 (attano ~aṃ bhikkhuṃ micchāvitakkabahulaṃ viharantaṃ ñatvā); — ( ii ) dutiyikā, f. , a wife ; Cp 2:4:2 (yā me dutiyikā āsi); Mil 401, 19 (cakkavāko yāva jīvitapariyādānā dutiyikaṃ na vijahati); Ud-a 72, 17 (purāṇadutiyikā ti pubbe … dutiyikā, bhariyā ti attho, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee dutiyā); — sadutiyaka , m. , sadutiyikā, f. , accompanied; with another person ; Vin IV 318, 11 (~ā ayyā ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se sadutiyā); — sadutiyakavāsa, m. [vāsa 3 ], living with a companion ; Ja I 10, 6 (gehassa atthibhāvo nāma sadutiyakavāso) = Ap-a 11, 34 = Bv-a 77, 23 .

sadutiyavihārī.p: [ sadutiya + vi + hara + ] (ti) CL=7 [In Ṇī. Thī - - vīhārinī ] One who is living with a companion.
